How to build a home gym
on a small budget
Start with a pull-up bar. It fits in a doorway and trains your back, arms and grip. One of the best tools for its price.
Get a pair of adjustable dumbbells. They replace a full rack and let you train every muscle group in a small space.
Add resistance bands. Cheap, light and perfect for warm-ups, mobility work and extra resistance on push-ups.
Buy a good mat. Floor work, stretching and core training are easier and kinder to your back on a proper surface.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. Train your mind at home too, right after your workout.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Train your mind at home too, right after your workout.

slides.texte_overlay: Look for second-hand equipment. People sell almost new weights all the time. You can build a full setup for very little.
Keep it visible. A home gym hidden in a cupboard gets forgotten. A small corner you see every day gets used.
